nature: post-hoc exploratory evaluation, designed after the first frozen Test (D, commit 0bb4815) had been opened; it never replaces D's frozen primary result
execution_order: E10 -> E9 -> E5 (E10 fixes the de-duplication used by E9 and E5)

inputs.taxonomy: data/taxonomy/item_taxonomy_v1.csv (frozen taxonomy_v1); stock codes mapped to l2_id, 'other' dropped, one count per category per basket, empty baskets kept in the denominator
inputs.true_labels: B frozen K-means K=3 labels (700 / 1,263 / 721 customers)

periods.discovery: [2010-06-01, 2010-12-01): build every rule list; in-sample descriptions only, never a conclusion
periods.validation: [2010-12-01, 2011-06-01): first out-of-sample evaluation; no setting is chosen from Validation results; E5 additionally confirms rules here by a pre-written rule
periods.test: [2011-06-01, 2011-12-01): NOT read in this stage. After the whole group confirms, every list and setting is frozen and committed, then Test is run exactly once and all results are reported

rule_config_P5.ranking: joint count desc, confidence desc, lift desc, rule_id asc (C's ranking)
rule_config_P5.rule_id: sha256(json.dumps(['l2', antecedent_l2_ids, consequent_l2_ids]))[:16], identical to C

coverage_definition: share of evaluated orders that contain every category of at least one deployed combination; each order counted once
customer_macro_coverage: mean over customers of each customer's own order coverage

bootstrap.interval: percentile 95%, paired (same resampled customers for both systems)

empirical_p: (1 + #random seeds with value >= real) / (1 + #seeds); one-sided, descriptive

primary_hypotheses_for_the_single_test_r.H_E9: E9, B=100: coverage(L per-customer lists) - coverage(G), paired customer interval
primary_hypotheses_for_the_single_test_r.H_E5a: E5a: direction-retention rate of real group-specific rules from Discovery to Test, versus the A1 distribution
primary_hypotheses_for_the_single_test_r.H_E5b: E5b: marginal coverage gain of Validation-confirmed group-specific slots, versus the A1 distribution
primary_hypotheses_for_the_single_test_r.multiplicity: Holm over these three; all E10 results and all other numbers are descriptive

known_information_before_registration: D's Validation and Test results for P5 (restricted/shared coverage, quality, specificity, P3 hybrid) had been read.
B had computed on Validation (P5, B=100): shared L has 100 directed slots but 55 distinct combinations, G has 92; at the same number of combinations shared L covers 70.44% vs G top-55 70.24%.
B had computed on Discovery P5 B=100 that L's combinations are mostly also in G's top-100 (C0 11/11, C1 28/29, C2 48/60).
No E5 group-specific list had been built or evaluated in any period.
